overview_description.description: Benchling is the modern software platform purpose-built for life science R&D. about_short_description.short_description: Benchling is an IT company that provides a cloud-based software platform for biology researchers and research and development organizations.

product.name: Benchling Bioresearch
product.description: A cloud-based R&D workspace for designing experiments, managing biological entities and samples, capturing results, coordinating workflows, and analyzing research data.

product.name: Benchling Bioprocess
product.description: A process-development platform for recipe design, experiment planning, batch execution, process data capture, tech transfer, and analysis of biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes.

product.name: Benchling AI
product.description: An AI interface embedded in the Benchling notebook for searching R&D data, importing and structuring files, analyzing experiments, drafting reports, and running scientific models.

product.name: Benchling Biologics
product.description: An antibody and protein R&D product for configuring molecular formats, registering sequences, characterizing proteins, tracking lineage, and linking wet-lab and computational data.

product.name: Benchling Automation
product.description: A laboratory automation product that connects instruments, orchestrates workflows, runs analysis, and records traceable results in the associated scientific record.

product.name: Benchling Connect
product.description: An instrument-connectivity product that transfers laboratory and R&D instrument data into structured Benchling records for downstream analysis and workflow use.
